title: Predictably Irrational
author: Dan Ariely
summary: Behavioral economist Dan Ariely uses playful experiments to show that people make irrational choices in consistent, predictable ways, covering topics like pricing, free offers, honesty and self-control.
readIf: you enjoy quick, anecdotal science about why we make odd choices with money and everyday decisions.
skipIf: you want rigorous methodology or a skeptical treatment of behavioral economics.
